model_purpose: Predicts 12-month SME default risk from bank-transaction cash-flow behaviour, business bureau data and director bureau data, and translates the resulting score into risk bands and indicative lending decisions for alternative lenders.

Very High Risk.rationale: Score falls in the lowest empirical band, where observed default rates are highest and materially above portfolio average.

High Risk.facility_limit_guidance: Reduced limit, short tenor, with additional bureau/affordability checks
High Risk.rationale: Elevated observed default rate. Suitable for manual review with compensating controls rather than automatic approval or decline.

Moderate Risk.facility_limit_guidance: Standard limit with tighter covenant (e.g. minimum balance, revenue-linked repayment)
Moderate Risk.rationale: Around portfolio-average risk. Approvable with standard affordability-linked conditions.

Low Risk.rationale: Below-average observed default rate, consistent with standard-terms lending.

Very Low Risk.facility_limit_guidance: Higher limit eligible, longer tenor eligible
Very Low Risk.rationale: Lowest observed default rate band. Eligible for preferred pricing and larger facility sizes.

policy_governance_note: Indicative pricing ranges, facility guidance, monitoring frequency and lending decisions are illustrative Orey Analytics business-policy assumptions. They are not estimated by the statistical scorecard and do not constitute live lending offers, regulated credit pricing or formal credit policy.
production_governance_status: Statistical validation passed — governance review required
governance_notes: Identifiers were excluded from model training and re-attached post-hoc for reporting only, using a verified positional relationship back to the Stage 02 engineered panel. The lending decision policy is a separate editable business-rules layer and is not part of the statistical model. Risk-band cutoffs were derived on the validation set only (Stage 06) and applied unchanged here. Passing statistical validation does not by itself constitute formal production approval.
pipeline_stages: 06 - Model validation, calibration and risk bands
07 - Final score, SME assessment and lending policy
next_stage: 08 - Score new/unscored applicants from the applicant scoring population and generate individual SME assessments and reason codes using scorecard_feature_points.csv.
